description: Corporate events of a company found by fixed rules in its filings: acquisitions, disposals, spin-offs, discontinued operations, reorganisations, stock splits, restatements, name changes and changes of fiscal year, each with its date, fiscal period, a sentence, the counterparty and amount where the filing names them, and its source document ids. Events are recorded for companies that file with the SEC.

at.description: an ISO date: the snapshot that was the latest on that date, in place of the latest snapshot

company.description: company id from search_companies, for example apple or mizuho

from.description: first date: a year (2024) or an ISO date

to.description: last date, in the same forms

name: get_events
title: Get corporate events
